evidence_quotes: Last onder dwangsom wegens herhaaldelijk lozen van afvalwater dat niet voldoet aan de in een omgevingsvergunning voorgeschreven concentratie-eis voor sulfaat
rationale: The Dutch District Court of The Hague (RBDHA) decision concerns an administrative enforcement order (last onder dwangsom) for repeatedly discharging wastewater (lozen van afvalwater) from storing non-inert goods (Activiteitenbesluit § 3.4.3) that allegedly exceeded the sulphate concentration limit prescribed in an environmental permit (omgevingsvergunning). Wastewater discharge regulation and effluent pollution enforcement fall squarely within WATER under both protocol labels, with primary category environmental_protection (industrial/commercial effluent pollution enforcement under permit/Activiteitenbesluit rules) and no household connection refusal or informal settlement issue.
